scenes.text: It's Tuesday, two in the afternoon. Your plumber is under a sink... and the phone rings.
Nobody answers. Mike hangs up, and calls the next plumber on Google.
Miss three calls like that a week, and that's three jobs gone.
The fix isn't fancy. When a call is missed, a text goes out within a minute.
Mike gets a text with a booking link. He picks a time. Your office calls him back to confirm.
Do this one now. It saves jobs you already paid to win.
Follow. I fix one business process like this every week.
